title: SX Bet socket + PinnWire Test fix (v0.117.2 building)
body: SX Bet had a socket switch in Settings > APIs but I never added a row to the Live tab's Sockets list, so it wasn't there. v0.117.2 adds it (and SX Bet is now selectable as the live price feed under Pinnodds live; real orders on it stay off until you allow them). Also from your PinnWire screenshot: the Test button called every HTTP 429 'used up today', but a 429 can be the per-minute limit; it now reads PinnWire's own window and retry time, and the meter no longer rests keys by the app's own count. Please re-tap Test on a PinnWire key after installing and send me the line it prints.
